page.notes: Marginal note "Persecutio in Anglia." is in the left margin beside the Tayler paragraph; its letters are roman with a long s, transcribed as printed. Two headings are set in spaced capitals and are rendered as level 2 under the running head. Several words in the main text are printed with heavy ink; the lower-right line "sequens" is cut off by the page edge, so the text there is unfinished (the paragraph continues on the next page). The first line of the scan is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "opinum" (likely "opimum") and "vstulatione" (likely "vexatione"/"vstulatione" as printed) are copied as they appear. Word "susceptum" and "studeret" copied as printed. Some words, including "summi" and "summáque", are printed with the s-form and are copied without change.
